releaseNotes: Coinbase is the easiest and most trusted place to buy, sell, and manage your digital currency. This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements.
description:
Coinbase is the most trusted platform to securely buy, sell, trade, stake and earn - crypto, stocks, prediction markets, derivatives and more. We’re the first publicly traded crypto exchange in the U.S. and the only crypto company listed on the S&P 500.

SUPPORTED ASSETS
Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), XRP (XRP), Solana (SOL), USD Coin (USDC), Cardano (ADA), Polygon (MATIC), Polkadot (DOT), Tether (USDT), Dai (DAI), Pepe (PEPE), SHIBA INU (SHIB), Dogecoin (DOGE) and more

BUY, SELL & MANAGE CRYPTO
Build, manage & track your crypto portfolio
Explore & trade millions of crypto assets¹
Earn rewards on stablecoins like USDC²
Stake crypto & earn rewards on cryptocurrencies like ETH & ADA³
Pay with crypto: Securely send & receive crypto internationally

PREDICTION MARKETS
Trade your take on thousands of real-world events across sports, politics, crypto, culture & more⁴
Buy, sell & adjust your positions in real time, as events unfold
Trade 24/7

STOCKS
Trade 24/5 with zero commission fees⁵
Pay instantly with USDC or USD
Buy fractional shares with as little as $1
Manage your stocks & crypto in one unified portfolio

COINBASE ONE
Zero trading fees, boosted staking rewards, priority support & more⁶
Rewards appear in real time in the app. See if you’re approved for Coinbase One Card with no credit score impact⁷

POWERFUL TOOLS FOR ADVANCED TRADING
Trade crypto using advanced tools. Express your market view by going long or short. Access powerful charting, real-time order books, and a range of order types across hundreds of crypto and equity markets.

SECURE & REGULATED CRYPTO EXCHANGE
All customer assets are held 1:1. We never trade against our customers or leverage their funds without consent
Our financials are public & audited quarterly by a Big 4 accounting firm
State-of-the-art encryption & security are at the core of our platform & our security team is constantly working to make sure you & your assets are protected from emerging threats
From auto-enrolled 2FA (with security key support), password protection, to multi-approval withdrawals in Coinbase Vault, we provide powerful security features to all our users
